stay.nearest_base: Jaon (last road village, 3 km below Singhad base camp); also Nirmand and Bagipul
stay.price_basis: Homestay: one registered Jaon homestay listed at 1,200 for two (extra bed 480, meals extra) per the bookstay.in search-result snippet; the page itself returned 403 so I did not read it. Undated.
stay.notes: Trek is a 35 km pilgrimage with no real lodging above Jaon. Official fixed rates on the trail during the yatra (Tribune, 1 Jul 2025): lodging 110-320 per night depending on altitude, breakfast 75-180, meals 110-290, snacks 35-75, tea 15-45. Tents 300-600 per night (justwravel, 25 Jul 2025) or 300-700 (heavenriders). Guest houses/budget hotels in Jaon and Nirmand 800-2,000 (mohitbangari.com guide); Jaon homestays 500-1,500 (heavenriders). Singhad base camp langar is free. Yatra window is short: tentatively third week of July to first week of August, subject to official confirmation.

taxi_day.basis: No private-cab fare from Rampur, Nirmand or Bagipul to Jaon was published on any page I could read, and no Rampur taxi union board found. Gozocabs lists Shimla-Jaon sedan at 13 per km. Route: Rampur to Jaon about 45-50 km, last 8 km from Bagi Pul is rough (unpaved).
taxi_day.notes: Local day cab is not a thing here; the cab is Shimla/Rampur to Jaon road head. Fees on the yatra in notes: registration is mandatory; official site is reported as 250 per pilgrim (search-result summary of shrikhandyatra.hp.gov.in; the site itself did not render in my fetch), justwravel.com (25 Jul 2025) says 200-300 non-refundable, refuje.com (14 Apr 2026) says online registration is free with a 50 yatra contribution at base camp. Porter 800-1,500 per day, local guide 1,500-3,000 per day (heavenriders; justwravel). Operator all-in packages 15,500-35,000 per person (search summary).

food_per_person_day.basis: Official fixed trail rates during the yatra (Tribune, 1 Jul 2025): breakfast 75-180, meals 110 at lower altitudes to 290 near Parvati Bagh, snacks 35-75, tea 15-45. Budget = breakfast 75 + two meals at 110 + one snack 35 + tea 15 = 345. Standard = mid-band breakfast 130 + two meals at 200 + snack 55 + tea 30 = 615. Jaon dhabas 100-200 per meal (justwravel; heavenriders).
food_per_person_day.notes: Applies only in the yatra window (about mid/late July to early August); outside it there is no food service above Jaon. Langar at Singhad is free.
